card.name: Endocarditis and bacteremia in antibiotic labels
card.fires_on: Pieces of the word endocarditis (End, ocard) and nearby words in S. aureus bacteremia dosing text. Also fires on spaces before dose numbers and on commas or phrases like Including in infection headings.

modes.label: Inside endocarditis
modes.description: The start or middle of the word endocarditis after bacteremia/ or Meningitis.
modes.example: S. aureus Bacteremia/<<End>>ocarditis Trial in Adult Patients

modes.label: S. aureus bloodstream infection headings
modes.description: Words in dosing headings about bloodstream infections and right-sided endocarditis.

modes.description: A space just before a concentration or duration figure in dosing instructions.
